key.name: show-icon
key.description: Whether the extension indicator is shown in the top panel.

key.name: icon-position
key.summary: Panel position for system status icon
key.description: Controls where the indicator appears in the panel: left, center, or right.

key.name: icon-index
key.description: Sets the indicator position within the selected panel group. Negative values push further toward the start of the group, 0 is the default start, and positive values move forward.

key.name: reminder-enabled
key.description: Controls whether the on-screen blink reminder overlay is shown.

key.name: reminder-opacity
key.description: Controls how transparent the blink reminder overlay appears, from 0 to 100 percent.

key.name: blink-interval
key.description: How long to wait after the reminder disappears before showing it again.

key.name: animation-duration
key.description: How long the reminder stays visible each time it appears.

key.name: fade-duration
key.description: How long the reminder takes to fade in and fade out.
